title: —Sabellius, the African, subtlest heresiarch of all the beasts of the field, held that the Father was Himself His Own Son.
html_source: Sabellius was a third-century priest considered a heretic by the Catholic church. He was excommunicated by Pope Callixtus I in 220 A.D. He is associated with the heresy called Patripassianism in which the Father is believed to have been incarnate and thus co-suffered with the Son Jesus on the cross. This opposes the traditional view that the divine is incapable of suffering.
